notes.title: Cartoon Network Journeys VR - UPDATE
notes.content:
Greetings dimension hopper,

For those of you hungry for more dimensional travel, we've got a trippy new update...
[list]
[*][b]Kosma Kwest: The Lost Episode[/b] has been added as a new bonus journey! To unlock, you must complete all three original journeys. Once accessible, the new journey card will be presented by Gormlorm and added to the dimensional deck.
[*][b]King Mode[/b] is now accessible via the dimensional deck in the desert. Unlock this bonus game mode after completing Jest to Impress.
[*]Valve Index and Knuckles support has been added.  
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[h2]KOSMA KWEST: THE LOST EPISODE  [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843812/a003e3f4d6f62761103b6cd30ee8dda4c3d5ca38.png[/img]

A tale of two capadildong caterpillars, each living in mirror opposite dimensions.  Befriend one and isolate the other. Learn the pointless importance of dimensional currency and balance - all while being guided by your favorite honey child deity, Kosma.  

This is a re-master of the original, unreleased pilot for Kosma Kwest. Created by the same Cartoon Network team that brought you Kosma Kwest. 

Until next time,
Gormlorm

notes.title: Beta Branch Updated with New Content
notes.content:
Hello,
The Beta branch has been updated with polish and bug fixes.  Here are a couple highlights:
[list]
[*]New content has been added!  You can unlock this content by completing Kosma Kwest.  Please report any bugs or feedback in the forums.
[*]Although we don't officially support Index, the latest build should allow Index users to play through the whole experience.
[/list]
Cheers,
Devs

notes.title: New Beta Build
notes.content:
Hello,
We've updated the beta branch with a new build that addresses the following issues:
[list]
[*][b]Total Playtime:[/b] Previously the total time played was inaccurate because it was only measuring the total time spent in the desert hub.  The latest build fixes this issue and will more accurately reflect the total time played.
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] A small number of players were having issues with achievements not being recorded properly.  This should be fixed with the latest beta build.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Longer than usual load time when retrying King Mode on Jester.
[*]Small visual inconsistencies with public branch.
[/list]
As always, please let us know of any issues in the forums. 

Cheers and Happy holidays!
